name: com.prereason/mcp
title: PreReason
description: Financial market context for AI agents: macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, companies and Bitcoin.

environmentVariables.name: PREREASON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PreReason API key (starts with pr_live_). Optional: without it the bridge asks for access from inside the session and prints one link for you to approve; the key is then saved under ~/.prereason. Or sign up at prereason.com.

environmentVariables.name: PREREASON_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: The app this bridge runs in (claude-desktop, cursor, windsurf, claude-code, ...), so your PreReason dashboard names the connection.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: PreReason API key, pasted as is with no prefix. Optional: without it the catalogue tools work.
